name: article-link-preview
purpose: Intent-loaded public page metadata for links in rendered article bodies, without mutating stored content.

endpoints.metadata: Signed HTTP(S) public article references; no redirects; WordPress safe HTTP denies private destinations

authentication: Public GET requires a valid HMAC for the exact URL and the current revision timestamp of a published, unprotected post. No outbound cookies or credentials.

retry.backoff: No automatic retry; negative cache for 5 minutes.

idempotency: Read-only metadata lookup. Does not alter article bodies or user data.
rate_limit: 30 uncached requests/minute per site as a soft concurrency limit; 256 KiB response cap; 12-hour metadata cache and 5-minute failure cache.
degradation: Keep link text, host and normal navigation if metadata/image is unavailable.
privacy: No cookies, localStorage or analytics. Public page URL leaves server only on preview intent. Preview image uses browser no-referrer; it exposes normal network address to its host. Metadata expires after 12 hours; no user-specific cache keys.
rollback: Revert code through tested release. No content migration or destructive uninstall.
